content: Our meetings are scheduled to take place every other Monday at 7:00 AM. The venue for these gatherings is the Galleria Food Court, located at 350 Longwood Avenue, Boston, Massachusetts. The inaugural international meeting of WikiDoc is set to occur from January 18th to January 20th, 2006. WikiDoc members from across the globe are cordially invited to participate in this significant event. The meeting will be held at 350 Longwood Avenue, Boston, Massachusetts, USA. A key agenda of this meeting will be the strategic organization and expansion of WikiDoc in countries such as Poland, Russia, China, and Romania. Additionally, a Gala Dinner is planned for January 18th at 5:30 PM, and it will also take place at 350 Longwood Avenue.
